column3: One metadata-only event per completed transaction or savepoint, offered from the transactions panel's own recorder at its completion, as BootUI offers it from TransactionRecorder.record (TransactionRecorder.java:315-336, TransactionPayload.java): one tracker, one routing, never SQL text, parameters or URL; produced whenever the transactions recorder runs, independent of SQL Trace; a commit is offered once its DBAPI commit has returned (the panel's settle: SQLAlchemy 2.1 has no event after the DBAPI commit returns, verified on Connection._commit_impl, ConnectionEvents, DialectEvents and PoolEvents), so a failed DBAPI commit is the panel's UNKNOWN with rolledBack false and failureClass its exception class (BootUI: status UNKNOWN, failureClass), and a successful commit is published at the connection's next begin, rollback or pool checkin: measured, commit(); sleep(0.3); close() gives durationNanos 302 ms and the event appears only at close, and a connection held open after a commit never publishes it; rolledBack is the panel's ROLLED_BACK after a write: a rollback of a transaction that ran no statement other than a SELECT (a read-only get_db Session SQLAlchemy rolls back on close) is offered rolledBack false, as BootUI's read-only transaction commits (coordinator default 2026-11-12, reversible by the owner), and a write is any statement not starting with SELECT, so a leading comment or WITH counts as one; the panel still lists such a transaction ROLLED_BACK; a connection under AUTOCOMMIT offers no event (each statement commits itself: no physical transaction for BootUI to record), the panel still lists it; nested is a savepoint or another transaction still open in this context (BootUI's thread stack, held weakly: a collected unclosed connection stops counting), while the panel's parentId stays savepoint-only; a paused panel keeps offering events through journal-only rows it never shows (BootUI TransactionRecorder.java:206-211, as P-sql's dispatch.py:107-108), and a paused panel with transaction not a journal source records and counts nothing; a suspended (low-footprint) hook offers no event, as P-sql; with the panel or SHARPIT_TRANSACTIONS_ENABLED off the insights treat transaction as not recorded (BootUI InsightsSnapshot.visible, ErrorsBehind2xx.java:112,157), a liveness check in the insights service rather than removing the source from the journal, so the journal keeps BootUI's configured sources; method is the row's call site, or unknown when sql_trace_capture_call_site is off (BootUI's @Transactional method has no Python twin); readOnly only from the postgresql_readonly execution option and isolation only from the isolation_level execution option; rollbackOnly false, ormStatements/ormFlushes/ormDirtyEntities -1 (no W5b orm source yet); not ported: the RuntimeEvent fields executionId, threadKind and failedOrSlow
